description: This file defines the TaskQueue class within the GuzzleHttpomise namespace. It implements a FIFO task queue used to settle promises asynchronously, maintaining a constant stack size. The class includes methods for adding tasks, running the queue, checking if it's empty, and disabling automatic shutdown behavior.

classes.name: TaskQueue
classes.description: A task queue that executes tasks in a FIFO order, used within GuzzleHttp promises to settle asynchronous tasks efficiently.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task queue and optionally registers a shutdown function to automatically run remaining tasks.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the task queue is empty.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a callable task to the queue.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes all tasks in the queue in FIFO order.

methods.name: disableShutdown
methods.description: Disables automatic shutdown execution of the task queue upon script termination.
